## Checklist

- [ ] The spec's `owner` is me, and I made these commits from my own computer
- [ ] **Spec PRs:** every acceptance criterion is specific and testable, and "Out of scope" names what this feature won't do
- [ ] **Code PRs:** the spec is already approved and merged
- [ ] **Code PRs:** there is a test for every acceptance criterion (`# AC1`, `# AC2`, ...)
- [ ] **Code PRs:** `pytest` passes, and I tried the feature in the browser
- [ ] **Code PRs:** only files in the spec's `paths` changed (or the spec was updated first)
- [ ] I didn't commit `.env`, `venv/` or other generated files
